specs.title: P15 profile and region save only whitelisted facts using actual version, then survive reload
P15 theme, contrast and density preview reset without storing business or identity state
P15 empty invalid draft survives explicit refresh and never sends a mutation
P15 notifications support overnight quiet hours and no invented delivery schedule
P15 notification conflict rebases metadata only and needs another explicit save
P15 uncertain notification response retains draft and the identical idempotency key
P15 readonly contexts cannot write or request native notification permission
P15 browser notification prompt requires a click and denial never prompts twice
P15 security reauthentication is real C01 verification without DELETE or persistent token
P15 device revoke is pending after 202 and cannot be repeated
P15 factor revoke is pending after 202 and cannot be repeated

specs.title: static settings HTML is guarded before any profile is rendered
profile save uses actual context, CSRF/CAS and a real accepted response
409 keeps draft and needs explicit rebase plus another save
notifications persist only approved settings fields
security confirmation really sends MFA/reauth/delete and 202 keeps the resource pending
MFA refusal never reaches reauth or delete and preserves a safe failure
offline recovery keeps unsaved drafts and requires explicit revalidation
downloads mint no lease on load and consume a fresh lease only on click
denied native notification permission is requested only once and falls back
settings HTTP 401 refuses before private read
settings HTTP 403 refuses before private read
settings HTTP 404 refuses before private read
four settings pages fit1440/390/CSS zoom and record axe without promoting native checks
read-only profile needs no unrelated downloads and cannot save
failed revalidation retains unsaved draft as read-only and explicit recovery restores editing
clipboard rejection shows manual copy and never claims success
foreign download lease is refused before navigation
